ranks: Phyrexia: All Will Be One (ONE, 2023-02-10) and Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander (ONC): whole sets; and older cards those batches' features unblocked

authored.name: Plague Nurse
authored.unblockedBy: this batch's hasToxic filter and grant-toxic

blocked.name: Nahiri, the Unforgiving
blocked.why: Compleated is built; her +1 "attacks a player each combat if able" needs a requirement that excludes planeswalkers and battles, and her 0 a token copy of the card she exiles from a graveyard.

blocked.name: Kaito, Dancing Shadow
blocked.why: 'you may activate loyalty abilities of Kaito twice this turn' has no shape (and the trigger's 'return one of them' picks from the damage batch).

blocked.name: Bladegraft Aspirant
blocked.why: abilityCostModification can't be limited to Equipment abilities that target this creature.

blocked.name: Vanish into Eternity
blocked.why: targetCostReduction only reduces; 'costs {3} more if it targets a creature' needs an increase.

blocked.name: Contagious Vorrac
blocked.why: 'If you didn't put a card into your hand this way, proliferate' — no this-way kind or look-and-choose 'if none chosen' tail.

blocked.name: Mesmerizing Dose
blocked.why: doesntUntap only covers the permanent carrying it, not 'enchanted creature doesn't untap'.

blocked.name: Thrun, Breaker of Silence
blocked.why: 'Can't be the target of nongreen spells/abilities from nongreen sources your opponents control' — no filtered hexproof (hexproof from colours can't say nongreen, which includes colorless).

blocked.name: Furnace Punisher
blocked.why: 'unless they control two or more basic lands' asks about the active player; the controls condition only counts the effect controller's permanents.

blocked.name: Melira, the Living Cure
blocked.why: No replacement capping poison counters at one plus 'can't get more this turn'; the exile ability also needs a this-turn 'when it's put into a graveyard, return it' delayed trigger on a target.

blocked.name: Churning Reservoir
blocked.why: Activation gate 'an oil counter was removed from a permanent you controlled this turn or a permanent with an oil counter on it was put into a graveyard this turn' isn't tracked.

blocked.name: Chiss-Goria, Forge Tyrant
blocked.why: Impulse exile of five where only one artifact spell may be cast this turn, and that spell gains affinity for artifacts — neither the single-cast limit nor granting affinity to the cast spell exists.

blocked.name: Goldwardens' Gambit
blocked.why: 'For each of those tokens, you may attach an Equipment you control to it' (chosen then attached all at once, per the ruling) has no shape.

blocked.name: Lukka, Bound to Ruin
blocked.why: Compleated is built; his −4 divides X damage, X the greatest power among your creatures as it's activated, and a divided total can't be dynamic.

blocked.name: Voidwing Hybrid
blocked.why: 'When you proliferate, return this card from your graveyard to your hand': no trigger on a proliferate (the 'proliferated' event exists, no trigger kind reads it).

blocked.name: Blade of Shared Souls
blocked.why: 'Whenever this Equipment becomes attached to a creature' has no trigger, and become-copy has no 'for as long as this Equipment remains attached to it' duration (until: end-of-turn / next-end-step / your-next-turn only).

blocked.name: Goliath Hatchery
blocked.why: Upkeep: 'choose a creature you control (untargeted, at resolution), then draw cards equal to its total toxic value' — no resolution-time choose-a-creature, and no EffectAmount reading a creature's total toxic value (702.164b).

blocked.name: The Filigree Sylex
blocked.why: Third ability's cost 'Remove ten oil counters from among permanents you control': removeCounter costs only come off the source.

blocked.name: Geth's Summons
blocked.why: Corrupted half: one optional target slot per opponent, each present only if that opponent had 3+ poison as you cast it; the seat slots (Sepulchral Primordial) carry no per-slot condition

blocked.name: Slobad, Iron Goblin
blocked.why: add-mana amount { manaValueOf: 'sacrificed' } reads nothing in a mana ability: the mana-ability path in Game (no stack) never sets lastKnownRefs.sacrificed, only the stack path does; authored and tested, it added 0 mana

blocked.name: Venser, Corpse Puppet
blocked.why: 'Whenever you proliferate' has no trigger (a 'proliferated' event exists but no trigger kind reads it)

blocked.name: Kinzu of the Bleak Coven
blocked.why: token copy 'except it's 1/1 and has toxic 1': CopyExceptions has basePt but no toxic grant (toxic isn't a Keyword)

blocked.name: Rhuk, Hexgold Nabber
blocked.why: on 'equipped creature dies' the Equipment is already unattached; needs the trigger object's last-known attachments, all-or-none, plus an 'equipped creature you control other than Rhuk attacks or dies' trigger

blocked.name: Serum-Core Chimera
blocked.why: 'you may discard a nonland card': the discard effect takes no filter, so a land could be chosen (the reflexive damage would correctly not fire, but the choice offered is wrong)

blocked.name: Mirage Mockery
blocked.why: Entwine {2}{U} (choose both modes for an extra cost) isn't modeled; no castModal option for it.

blocked.name: Synthesis Pod
blocked.why: Cost 'Exile a spell you control' (a spell on the stack) has no AbilityCost; the reveal-until also reads the exiled spell's mana value + 1.

blocked.name: Noxious Assault
blocked.why: 'Whenever a creature blocks this turn, its controller gets a poison counter' is a repeating delayed trigger for the rest of the turn; delayed-trigger has no such timing.

blocked.name: Bring the Ending
blocked.why: Corrupted reads the targeted spell's controller's poison counters; player-counters is only you / an opponent / that-player, and nothing scopes 'that-player' to a target's controller.

blocked.name: Anoint with Affliction
blocked.why: Corrupted reads the targeted creature's controller's poison counters (the ruling: exiled regardless of MV then); no condition or filter reads a target's controller's counters.

blocked.name: Tamiyo's Logbook
blocked.why: '{1} less for each OTHER artifact you control': costReduction countOf has no exclude-self, and the Logbook is itself an artifact (would reduce by one too many).

blocked.name: Cruel Grimnarch
blocked.why: 'For each opponent who can't [discard], you gain 4 life' — no per-player could-not-discard count.

blocked.name: Glissa's Retriever
blocked.why: "return up to X target cards", X = opponents with 3+ poison: an any-number group's max is only a number or the spell's X, not an amount read as the reflexive trigger goes on the stack

blocked.name: Capricious Hellraiser
blocked.why: "exile three cards at random from your graveyard. Choose a noncreature, nonland card from among them and copy it": choose-random-card picks one card only; no N-at-random then choose-among-those

blocked.name: Awaken the Sleeper
blocked.why: "you may destroy all Equipment attached to that creature": no CardFilter clause for 'attached to the object in target slot N'

blocked.name: Mirran Safehouse
blocked.why: "has all activated abilities of all land cards in all graveyards": only linked-exile ability grants exist (Territory Forge, Steward of the Harvest)

blocked.name: Maze's Mantle
blocked.why: "That creature gains hexproof": no effect can point at the enchanted creature (its intervening-if is `source` with `attachedTo: { hasToxic: true }`, built).

blocked.name: Nahiri's Sacrifice
blocked.why: X damage divided among any number of targets (dynamic total), with X set by the additional cost 'sacrifice an artifact or creature with mana value X'

blocked.name: Ria Ivor, Bane of Bladehold
blocked.why: 'the next time target creature would deal combat damage to one or more players this combat, prevent that damage; create that many Mites' — no one-shot next-time prevention by a target creature that counts what it prevented

blocked.name: Monument to Perfection
blocked.why: second ability: becomes a 9/9 that 'gains indestructible and toxic 9' — animate can't grant toxic N (no modifier carries toxic). The condition (controls with distinctNames) and the search are expressible

blocked.name: Viral Spawning
blocked.why: 'As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters and this card is in your graveyard, it has flashback {2}{G}' — flashback has no condition field

blocked.name: Everything Comes to Dust
blocked.why: 'except those that share a creature type with a creature that convoked this spell': sharesCreatureTypeWith only takes "trigger-object"; no filter reads the convokers' creature types.

blocked.name: Invasion of Fiora // Marchesa, Resolute Monarch
blocked.why: Back face: 'remove all counters from up to one target permanent' (remove-counter needs one kind) and the intervening-if 'if you haven't been dealt combat damage since your last turn' has no condition. The front face alone is authorable (modal destroy-all legendary / nonlegendary).

blocked.name: Invasion of Ikoria // Zilortha, Apex of Ikoria
blocked.why: Back face: 'for each non-Human creature you control, you may have that creature assign its combat damage as though it weren't blocked' has no static.

blocked.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
blocked.why: Back face: 'Noncreature spells you cast have convoke' — only spellsHaveDelve exists, no convoke grant.

blocked.name: Skrelv's Hive
blocked.why: Corrupted 'creatures you control with toxic have lifelink': hasToxic inside the layer fold reads only printed toxic, so a creature granted toxic (grant-toxic, grantToxic) wouldn't get lifelink; AUTHORING §5 names this card as not yet expressible.

blocked.name: Elusive Otter // Grove's Bounty
blocked.why: Adventure: 'Distribute X +1/+1 counters' — divided.total is a fixed number, no X total.

blocked.name: Vastwood Hydra
blocked.why: Dies trigger: 'you may distribute N counters (N = its +1/+1 counters, LKI) among any number of creatures you control' — untargeted, chosen on resolution, variable total; counters-divided only does targeted fixed totals.

blocked.name: Observed Stasis
blocked.why: ETB 'remove enchanted creature from combat. Then draw a card for each tapped creature its controller controls': no EffectTargetRef for the Aura's enchanted creature, and no count read from that creature's controller ("opponent" would count every opponent in multiplayer).

blocked.name: Shay Cormac
blocked.why: 'lose hexproof, indestructible, protection, shroud, and ward': lose-keywords takes Keyword strings; protection and ward aren't keywords in that union, so they can't be taken away.

blocked.name: Revival of the Ancestors
blocked.why: Chapter II 'distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures you control': SagaChapter has no `divided` field (only spells and activated/triggered abilities do), so the division can't be announced for a chapter.
